title: Dental PPO Plans Coverage in Force on the Date of Service and Premium Grace Periods
content:
**Coverage on the date of service.** A line under the Dental PPO Plans is payable only if the enrollment was active on its date of service: on or after the coverage effective date and, when a termination date is set, on or before it. A line outside that span, or under a cancelled enrollment, is denied as not eligible.

**Completion-dated procedures.** For a crown, bridge, denture or root canal the date of service is the completion date, so a procedure started while covered but completed after the termination date is denied, while one started before the coverage effective date and completed after it is payable.

**Premium grace periods.**
- When the funding billing account is in a grace period and the enrollment is an individual exchange enrollment with advance premium tax credit, lines with a date of service in the first month of the grace period are adjudicated normally, and lines with a date of service in the second or third month are pended with the premium-grace pend remark.
- A line may be pended only while the funding billing account is in a grace period (as the billing account record shows).
- When the grace period is cured by full payment, each pended line is released and adjudicated normally as a new decision referencing the pended line; when the account lapses instead, coverage ends on the last day of the first grace month and each pended line is denied as not eligible, referencing the pended line.
- Lines with a date of service during the grace period of any other billing arrangement are adjudicated normally while the account is in a grace period, and are reprocessed as not eligible if the account later lapses with a paid-through date before the date of service.

### Span check (hypothetical enrollment, effective 1 April, terminated 30 September)
| Date of service | Result |
|---|---|
| 31 March | Denied as not eligible |
| 1 April | Within coverage |
| 30 September | Within coverage |
| 1 October | Denied as not eligible |
